title: Sequence Effect on the Bending Elasticity of Double-Stranded DNA.
authors: Dong, Hai-Long; Zheng, Chen-Chen; Yu, Ting
journal: The journal of physical chemistry. B
one_liner_zh: 该文通过全原子分子动力学模拟研究DNA序列对其弯曲弹性的影响，并建立预测模型，虽未直接聚焦TF-DNA结合，但为蛋白质-DNA互作中的DNA构象柔性提供了关键物理基础和方法参考。
abstract: The sequence effect on double-stranded DNA elasticity is crucial for DNA-protein binding and recognition. Here, we employed extensive all-atom molecular dynamics simulations to investigate the relationships between DNA sequences and its bending elasticity through involving DNA crookedness for describing sequence-dependent local bends of base pair centers. Our results demonstrated that the increase of DNA crookedness due to its sequence leads to the decrease of DNA bending stiffness. Based on such relationship, we established a predictive model that quantitatively connects DNA bending persistence length and its sequence, which was validated by extensive experimental data. Moreover, our analyses revealed that the fluctuation of base-pair inclination along DNA and local base pair Lennard-Jones interactions between atoms in rings and major grooves, rather than total atoms of base pair, play critical roles in sequence-dependent DNA bending flexibility. The software of the predictive model is freely available at https://github.com/Dong-group/Pdna-seq.
abstract_zh: 序列效应对双链DNA弹性的影响对于DNA-蛋白质结合和识别至关重要。在此，我们采用广泛的全程原子分子动力学模拟，通过引入DNA弯曲度（crookedness）来描述碱基对中心的序列依赖性局部弯曲，从而探究DNA序列与其弯曲弹性之间的关系。我们的结果表明，由序列引起的DNA弯曲度增加导致DNA弯曲刚度降低。基于这种关系，我们建立了一个预测模型，定量地将DNA弯曲持久长度与其序列联系起来，并通过大量实验数据进行了验证。此外，我们的分析揭示，沿DNA的碱基对倾斜波动以及环内原子与主沟之间局部碱基对Lennard-Jones相互作用，而非碱基对的总原子数，在序列依赖性DNA弯曲柔性中起关键作用。该预测模型的软件可在https://github.com/Dong-group/Pdna-seq免费获取。
